evals.prompt: Search the web and tell me the latest on x402 adoption, with sources.
evals.expected_output: Runs the perplexity-search step (POST /search) and returns a short cited brief synthesized from the web results.
assertions: the agent tells the user the ~$0.01 cost before spending
the final answer cites source URLs from the search results

evals.prompt: Do a grounded web read on how agentic payment rails are being adopted this month.
evals.expected_output: Runs perplexity-search with recency=month and synthesizes a cited answer.
assertions: recency is set to a valid enum value (hour|day|week|month|year)
no paid call is made for a question answerable without live web data

evals.prompt: Summarize the article I pasted above in three bullets.
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger; the agent summarizes the supplied text itself.
assertions: no paid call is made for content the user already supplied

evals.prompt: Is NVDA looking bullish or bearish this week based on the chart, news, and Reddit?
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger; this is a directional stock read that stock-direction-signals covers.

evals.prompt: Who is @sama on Twitter and what has he posted lately?
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger; this is a Twitter/X account read that twitter-research covers.

evals.prompt: Explain how a hash map works.
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger; the model answers from its own knowledge.
